description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project. It acts as a decorator for the InterviewAttachment entity, providing methods to retrieve file content and associate an interview by ID.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for InterviewAttachment entity that adds additional functionalities such as retrieving file content as a string or resource and setting related interview by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an InterviewAttachment object.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content associated with the interview attachment, converting resource streams to strings if necessary.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Protected method that returns the underlying InterviewAttachment entity.

methods.name: setInterviewById
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with the attachment based on the provided interview ID.
